acceptance_checks: P1.3.1 is satisfied by reducing scripts/shiki.py to a thin executable shim that delegates parser construction and dispatch to importable modules.
P1.3.2 is satisfied by moving process, config, installer, git, GitHub, bootstrap, task, runtime, and CLI responsibilities into focused dependency-free shiki_* modules.
Behavior is preserved for existing init, bootstrap-platform, bootstrap-github, install-target, task, runner, and daemon command surfaces.
Existing P0.2 dry-run / execute safety flags remain available and unchanged.
Target installation and manifest staging include every module required by the shim.
scripts/test_shiki_module_boundaries.sh and scripts/validate_shiki.py enforce the module boundary contract.
Verification bundle passes: validate_shiki, py_compile, scripts/test_shiki_*.sh, CLI help smoke checks, and git diff --check.
non_goals: Do not implement P1.3.3 runtime adapter registry or process isolation.
Do not implement P1.3.4 pluggable GitHub provider abstraction.
Do not implement P1.3.5 persistent daemon/service manager redesign.
Do not implement P1.3.6 packaging entrypoint redesign.
Do not implement P1.4 governance or evidence model hardening.
Do not implement P2 repository presentation, release, or onboarding work.
Do not change Guardian approval policy or CCA Review Bridge behavior.
Do not change branch protection behavior or CODEOWNERS ownership rules.
Do not change P0.4 state ID, ledger, lock, untrusted PR, live-state, or adversarial evidence semantics.
Do not change Node.js 20 / Claude / CCA deferred workflow handling from T-0039.
scope: Close Goal #30 P1.3.1-P1.3.2 by splitting scripts/shiki.py into maintainable standard-library modules while preserving existing CLI behavior, bootstrap/init safety semantics, target install behavior, validation, and tests.
title: Split Shiki CLI into maintainable modules
